name: Kistarcsa (Hungary)
description: Two vertical stripes of red and blue in the ratio 1:2, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kistarcsa: a blue shield with a white cockerel, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling.
history: The arms and flag of Kistarcsa and their use are regulated by municipal decree 17/1997. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kistarcsa arms with helm, crest and mantling
